name: Ricki Ruiz

bio.statement: His official biography calls him one of Oregon's youngest state legislators.
bio.excerpt: one of Oregon's youngest state legislators.

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Ruiz member page

bio.statement: His official biography says he was elected to the Reynolds School District board in 2017.
bio.excerpt: youngest school board member in Reynolds School District

source.publisher: Oregon Legislature, Rep. Ruiz member page

bio.statement: His campaign site says he was raised in Gresham and was the first in his family to graduate from high school.
bio.excerpt: Ricki was the first member of his family to graduate from high school

source.publisher: Ricki Ruiz campaign website

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists Ruiz's occupation as parks recreation, with a background in youth and family recreation and crime prevention.
bio.excerpt: Occupation: Parks Recreation Occupational Background: Youth and Family Recreation, Crime Prevention

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 57

bio.statement: His pamphlet statement lists a bachelor's from Warner Pacific University and Reynolds High School as his educational background.
bio.excerpt: Educational Background: Bachelor’s, Warner Pacific University; Reynolds High School

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 57

positions.statement: His campaign priorities page says addressing the rising cost of living is a priority, including reducing utility costs and supporting childcare assistance.
positions.excerpt: I will work to reduce utility costs and support programs that provide childcare assistance.

source.publisher: Ricki Ruiz campaign website

positions.statement: His priorities page says improving public safety in Gresham and Oregon is crucial.
positions.excerpt: Supporting and improving public safety in Gresham and Oregon is crucial

source.publisher: Ricki Ruiz campaign website

positions.statement: His priorities page says he will prioritize housing and homelessness, including expanding affordable housing and supportive services.
positions.excerpt: expanding affordable housing developments, increasing funding for supportive services

source.publisher: Ricki Ruiz campaign website

positions.statement: His priorities page says he will prioritize addressing substance addiction through treatment and mental health services.
positions.excerpt: expanding access to comprehensive treatment programs and mental health services

source.publisher: Ricki Ruiz campaign website

positions.statement: His priorities page says he will advocate for equitable, quality education from early childhood to higher education.
positions.excerpt: I will advocate for equitable and quality education, from early childhood to higher education.

source.publisher: Ricki Ruiz campaign website

positions.statement: Ruiz says in his pamphlet statement that he will improve Oregon's school funding distribution so the highest-poverty districts are not left behind.
positions.excerpt: Improve Oregon’s school funding distribution model so that our highest-poverty districts are not left behind.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 57

positions.statement: Ruiz says in his pamphlet statement that he will lengthen the school year and strengthen and expand summer learning.
positions.excerpt: Lengthen the school year so our kids aren’t shorted their opportunity to learn.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 57

positions.statement: Ruiz says in his pamphlet statement that he will protect the Oregon Health Plan and expand access to behavioral healthcare.
positions.excerpt: Protect the Oregon Health Plan, expand access to behavioral healthcare.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 57

positions.statement: Ruiz says in his pamphlet statement that he will keep defending Oregonians against policies that use fear to divide them, as the son of immigrants.
positions.excerpt: I will continue defending all Oregonians against policies that use fear to divide us.

source.publisher: Oregon Secretary of State, Voters' Pamphlet (Multnomah County edition), p. 57

gaps: Campaign site appears to date from an earlier cycle (mentions 2024 school health center); 2026 currency unconfirmed
No voting or sponsorship items collected (phase 1 scope)
collection_notes: Incumbent per oregonlegislature.gov member page. Campaign domain ricki4oregon.com from Ballotpedia 2020 survey data; the site's metadata mentions an unrelated 'Candidate for Portland Mayor' label and the body text describes a third-term bid, so it may be a 2024 cycle site. Reviewer should confirm the domain is still his 2026 site. Matches inventory. Bio cap (5) reached: pamphlet prior governmental experience (Reynolds School Board; National Hispanic Caucus of State Legislators Education Vice Chair) not itemized. Website ricki4oregon.com already recorded; not re-fetched.
